wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |CoachRank= |APRank= |mode=Basketball |year=2015–16 |team=Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets |image=Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Atlantic Coast Conference |division= |short_conf=ACC |record=21–15 |conf_record=8–10 |head_coach=[[Brian Gregory]] |hc_year = 5th |asst_coach1=Chad Dollar |asst_coach2=[[Mamadou N'Diaye (basketball, born 1975)|Mamadou N'Diaye]] |asst_coach3=[[Tom Herrion]] |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[McCamish Pavilion]] |champion= |bowl=[[2016 NIT|NIT]] |bowl_result=Quarterfinals }} {{2015–16 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team''' represented the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by fifth year head coach [[Brian Gregory]] and played their home games at [[Hank McCamish Pavilion|McCamish Pavilion]]. They were members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Yellow Jackets finished the season 21–15, 8–10 in [[2015–16 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a tie for 11th place. They defeated [[2015–16 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]] in the second round of the [[2016 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]]. They received an invitation to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] and [[2015–16 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|South Carolina]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]]. On March 25, 2016, Georgia Tech announced Brian Gregory would not return as head coach.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/15067516/brian-gregory-not-return-georgia-tech-head-coach|title=Georgia Tech parts with Gregory as head coach|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2016-03-29}} ==Last season== The [[2014–15 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team|Yellow Jackets]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball rankings|2014–15 season]] 12–19, 3–15 in [[2015–16 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in 14th place.
